title: Add system keyword constants (RFC 8621 §4.1.1)
description: RFC 8621 §4.1.1 defines system keywords that callers use as HashMap keys in Email.keywords. Without named constants, callers hardcode magic strings and typos silently produce missing functionality. System keywords: $seen, $answered, $flagged, $draft, $forwarded, $phishing, $mdnsent. RFC 8621 §4.1.1 also notes that IMAP keywords may appear; only the JMAP-defined ones need constants.
design: A pub mod keyword with pub const str values, e.g. pub const SEEN: &str = '$seen'. Alternatively a Keyword newtype wrapping String with associated consts. The simpler &str consts are easier to use as HashMap keys and add no allocation overhead.
